# julia_core/JAIDE_v15_Core.jl
# julia_core/JAIDE_v15_Core.jl
# JAIDE v15 Advanced Hybrid AMF Core Implementation
# Hibrid AMF (Attention-Mamba Fusion) architektúra FlashMLA és Mamba2 integrációval

using LinearAlgebra
using CUDA
using Statistics
using JSON3
using Flux

# Hibrid AMF blokk definíció
struct HybridAMFBlock
    # FlashMLA komponensek
    query_proj::Dense
    key_proj::Dense
    value_proj::Dense
    output_proj::Dense
    
    # Mamba2 komponensek
    x_proj::Dense
    dt_proj::Dense
    A_log::AbstractArray
    D::AbstractArray
    
    # AMF fúziós paraméterek
    fusion_gate::Dense
    alpha_weight::Float32
    beta_weight::Float32
    
    # Normalizációs rétegek
    norm1::LayerNorm
    norm2::LayerNorm
    
    # Konfigurációs paraméterek
    hidden_size::Int
    num_heads::Int
    head_dim::Int
    state_size::Int
end

# FlashMLA implementáció
function flash_mla_attention(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray, mask=nothing)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    # Query, Key, Value projekciók
    q = reshape(block.query_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    k = reshape(block.key_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    v = reshape(block.value_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    
    # Optimalizált flash attention számítás
    q = permutedims(q, (1, 3, 2, 4))  # [batch, heads, seq, head_dim]
    k = permutedims(k, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    v = permutedims(v, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    
    # Attention súlyok számítása blokkonként (FlashAttention stílusban)
    scale = 1.0f0 / sqrt(Float32(block.head_dim))
    attn_output = zeros(Float32, batch_size, block.num_heads, seq_len, block.head_dim)
    
    block_size = 128  # FlashAttention blokk méret
    for i in 1:block_size:seq_len
        i_end = min(i + block_size - 1, seq_len)
        for j in 1:block_size:seq_len
            j_end = min(j + block_size - 1, seq_len)
            
            # Blokk-alapú attention számítás
            q_block = q[:, :, i:i_end, :]
            k_block = k[:, :, j:j_end, :]
            v_block = v[:, :, j:j_end, :]
            
            scores = batched_mul(q_block, permutedims(k_block, (1, 2, 4, 3))) .* scale
            
            if mask !== nothing
                scores .+= mask[i:i_end, j:j_end]
            end
            
            attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
            attn_block = batched_mul(attn_weights, v_block)
            
            attn_output[:, :, i:i_end, :] .+= attn_block
        end
    end
    
    # Kimenet átformázása és projekció
    attn_output = permutedims(attn_output, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    attn_output = reshape(attn_output, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    return block.output_proj(attn_output)
end

# Mamba2 állapot-tér modell implementáció
function mamba2_ssm(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    # Projekciók
    x_proj = block.x_proj(x)
    dt = sigmoid.(block.dt_proj(x))  # Delta time paraméterek
    
    # A mátrix exponenciális (discretized)
    A = exp.(block.A_log)  # [state_size, hidden_size]
    
    # Állapot inicializálás
    h = zeros(Float32, batch_size, block.state_size, hidden_size)
    outputs = zeros(Float32, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    # Szekvenciális feldolgozás Mamba2 stílusban
    for t in 1:seq_len
        x_t = x_proj[:, t, :]  # [batch, hidden]
        dt_t = dt[:, t, :]     # [batch, hidden]
        
        # Állapot frissítés
        h = h .* reshape(A, 1, block.state_size, hidden_size) .+ 
            reshape(x_t, batch_size, 1, hidden_size)
        
        # Kimenet számítás
        y_t = sum(h .* reshape(dt_t, batch_size, 1, hidden_size), dims=2)
        outputs[:, t, :] = reshape(y_t, batch_size, hidden_size)
    end
    
    # D skip connection hozzáadás
    outputs .+= x .* reshape(block.D, 1, 1, hidden_size)
    
    return outputs
end

# AMF fúziós mechanizmus
function amf_fusion(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray, mask=nothing)
    # Normalizált bemenetek
    x_norm1 = block.norm1(x)
    x_norm2 = block.norm2(x)
    
    # FlashMLA és Mamba2 kimenetei
    flash_out = flash_mla_attention(block, x_norm1, mask)
    mamba_out = mamba2_ssm(block, x_norm2)
    
    # Adaptív fúzió gate
    fusion_weights = sigmoid.(block.fusion_gate(x))
    
    # Súlyozott kombinálás
    alpha = block.alpha_weight * fusion_weights
    beta = block.beta_weight * (1.0f0 .- fusion_weights)
    
    fused_output = alpha .* flash_out .+ beta .* mamba_out
    
    # Residual connection
    return x .+ fused_output
end

# Dinamikus pozíciós kódolás (YaRN/LongRoPE alapú)
function dynamic_positional_encoding(seq_len::Int, hidden_size::Int, theta::Float32=10000.0f0)
    pos = collect(0:seq_len-1)
    dims = collect(0:2:hidden_size-1)
    
    # YaRN-style dynamic scaling
    scale_factor = max(1.0f0, log(Float32(seq_len) / 4096.0f0))
    adjusted_theta = theta * scale_factor
    
    # RoPE frekvenciák számítása
    freqs = 1.0f0 ./ (adjusted_theta .^ (dims ./ hidden_size))
    
    # Pozíciós encoding mátrix
    pos_enc = zeros(Float32, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    for i in 1:seq_len
        for j in 1:2:hidden_size
            angle = pos[i] * freqs[div(j+1, 2)]
            pos_enc[i, j] = sin(angle)
            if j < hidden_size
                pos_enc[i, j+1] = cos(angle)
            end
        end
    end
    
    return pos_enc
end

# SEAL mechanizmus a hosszú szekvenciákhoz
function seal_mechanism(x::AbstractArray, memory_length::Int=65536)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    if seq_len <= memory_length
        return x  # Nincs szükség tömörítésre
    end
    
    # Adaptív tömörítés
    compress_ratio = div(seq_len, memory_length)
    compressed_seq = zeros(Float32, batch_size, memory_length, hidden_size)
    
    for i in 1:memory_length
        start_idx = (i-1) * compress_ratio + 1
        end_idx = min(i * compress_ratio, seq_len)
        
        if start_idx <= end_idx
            # Átlagolás alapú tömörítés
            compressed_seq[:, i, :] = mean(x[:, start_idx:end_idx, :], dims=2)
        end
    end
    
    return compressed_seq
end

# Teljes JAIDE v15 modell
struct JAIDEv15Model
    embedding::Embedding
    pos_encoding::AbstractArray
    
    # Hibrid AMF blokkok
    amf_blocks::Vector{HybridAMFBlock}
    
    # Kimeneti rétegek
    final_norm::LayerNorm
    lm_head::Dense
    
    # Konfigurációs paraméterek
    config::Dict{String, Any}
end

# Modell forward pass
function forward(model::JAIDEv15Model, input_ids::AbstractArray, attention_mask=nothing)
    batch_size, seq_len = size(input_ids)
    
    # Token embedding
    x = model.embedding(input_ids)
    
    # Dinamikus pozíciós kódolás hozzáadása
    pos_enc = dynamic_positional_encoding(seq_len, size(x, 3))
    x = x .+ reshape(pos_enc, 1, seq_len, size(x, 3))
    
    # SEAL mechanizmus alkalmazása hosszú szekvenciákhoz
    x = seal_mechanism(x, model.config["memory_length"])
    
    # Hibrid AMF blokkok iterálása
    for block in model.amf_blocks
        x = amf_fusion(block, x, attention_mask)
    end
    
    # Finális normalizálás és kimenet
    x = model.final_norm(x)
    logits = model.lm_head(x)
    
    return logits
end

# Modell konstruktor
function create_jaide_v15_model(config::Dict{String, Any})
    hidden_size = config["hidden_size"]
    num_layers = config["num_layers"]
    num_heads = config["num_heads"]
    vocab_size = config["vocab_size"]
    max_seq_len = config["max_seq_len"]
    
    # Embedding rétegek
    embedding = Embedding(vocab_size => hidden_size)
    pos_encoding = dynamic_positional_encoding(max_seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    # AMF blokkok létrehozása
    amf_blocks = []
    for i in 1:num_layers
        block = HybridAMFBlock(
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # query_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # key_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # value_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # output_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # x_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # dt_proj
            randn(Float32, hidden_size, hidden_size),  # A_log
            randn(Float32, hidden_size),  # D
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # fusion_gate
            0.5f0,  # alpha_weight
            0.5f0,  # beta_weight
            LayerNorm(hidden_size),  # norm1
            LayerNorm(hidden_size),  # norm2
            hidden_size,
            num_heads,
            div(hidden_size, num_heads),
            hidden_size
        )
        push!(amf_blocks, block)
    end
    
    # Kimeneti rétegek
    final_norm = LayerNorm(hidden_size)
    lm_head = Dense(hidden_size => vocab_size)
    
    return JAIDEv15Model(
        embedding,
        pos_encoding,
        amf_blocks,
        final_norm,
        lm_head,
        config
    )
end

# Segéd függvények
function batched_mul(a::AbstractArray, b::AbstractArray)
    return batched_transpose(batched_transpose(a) * batched_transpose(b))
end

function batched_transpose(x::AbstractArray)
    return permutedims(x, (1, 2, 4, 3))
end

# Exportálás Python integrációhoz
export JAIDEv15Model, HybridAMFBlock, create_jaide_v15_model, forward
export flash_mla_attention, mamba2_ssm, amf_fusion
export dynamic_positional_encoding, seal_mechanism

# elixir_api/lib/jaide_v15_api/memory_manager.ex
# elixir_api/lib/jaide_v15_api/memory_manager.ex
# DeepSpeed ZeRO-Offload elvei alapú GPU memória monitor és súly kezelő

defmodule JAIDEv15Api.MemoryManager do
  @moduledoc """
  GPU memória monitorozó és súly offload kezelő GenServer
  DeepSpeed ZeRO-Offload alapú implementáció
  """
  
  use GenServer
  require Logger
  
  # Állapot struktúra
  defstruct [
    :gpu_memory_total,
    :gpu_memory_used,
    :gpu_memory_free,
    :cpu_memory_used,
    :offload_threshold,
    :offload_strategy,
    :julia_bridge_pid,
    :weight_cache,
    :offload_queue,
    :monitoring_interval,
    :last_check,
    :memory_pressure_level
  ]
  
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
    gpu_memory_total: non_neg_integer(),
    gpu_memory_used: non_neg_integer(),
    gpu_memory_free: non_neg_integer(),
    cpu_memory_used: non_neg_integer(),
    offload_threshold: float(),
    offload_strategy: atom(),
    julia_bridge_pid: pid() | nil,
    weight_cache: map(),
    offload_queue: list(),
    monitoring_interval: non_neg_integer(),
    last_check: DateTime.t(),
    memory_pressure_level: atom()
  }
  
  # API függvények
  
  @spec start_link(keyword()) :: GenServer.on_start()
  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end
  
  @spec get_memory_status() :: map()
  def get_memory_status do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_memory_status)
  end
  
  @spec offload_weights(list()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
  def offload_weights(layer_names) when is_list(layer_names) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:offload_weights, layer_names})
  end
  
  @spec restore_weights(list()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
  def restore_weights(layer_names) when is_list(layer_names) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:restore_weights, layer_names})
  end
  
  @spec set_offload_threshold(float()) :: :ok
  def set_offload_threshold(threshold) when threshold > 0.0 and threshold < 1.0 do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:set_offload_threshold, threshold})
  end
  
  @spec get_memory_pressure() :: atom()
  def get_memory_pressure do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_memory_pressure)
  end
  
  # GenServer callbacks
  
  @impl GenServer
  def init(opts) do
    julia_bridge_pid = Keyword.get(opts, :julia_bridge_pid)
    offload_threshold = Keyword.get(opts, :offload_threshold, 0.85)
    monitoring_interval = Keyword.get(opts, :monitoring_interval, 1000)
    
    initial_state = %__MODULE__{
      gpu_memory_total: 0,
      gpu_memory_used: 0,
      gpu_memory_free: 0,
      cpu_memory_used: 0,
      offload_threshold: offload_threshold,
      offload_strategy: :lru,
      julia_bridge_pid: julia_bridge_pid,
      weight_cache: %{},
      offload_queue: [],
      monitoring_interval: monitoring_interval,
      last_check: DateTime.utc_now(),
      memory_pressure_level: :low
    }
    
    # Kezdeti memória állapot lekérdezése
    {:ok, state} = update_memory_status(initial_state)
    
    # Periodikus memória ellenőrzés indítása
    schedule_memory_check(monitoring_interval)
    
    Logger.info("MemoryManager elindult. GPU memória: #{format_memory(state.gpu_memory_total)}")
    
    {:ok, state}
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_call(:get_memory_status, _from, state) do
    status = %{
      gpu_total: state.gpu_memory_total,
      gpu_used: state.gpu_memory_used,
      gpu_free: state.gpu_memory_free,
      gpu_utilization: gpu_utilization(state),
      cpu_used: state.cpu_memory_used,
      memory_pressure: state.memory_pressure_level,
      offload_threshold: state.offload_threshold,
      cached_weights: map_size(state.weight_cache),
      offload_queue_size: length(state.offload_queue)
    }
    
    {:reply, status, state}
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_call({:offload_weights, layer_names}, _from, state) do
    case offload_weights_to_cpu(layer_names, state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        Logger.info("Súlyok offload befejezve: #{inspect(layer_names)}")
        {:reply, :ok, new_state}
      
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Súly offload hiba: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_call({:restore_weights, layer_names}, _from, state) do
    case restore_weights_to_gpu(layer_names, state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        Logger.info("Súlyok visszaállítva GPU-ra: #{inspect(layer_names)}")
        {:reply, :ok, new_state}
      
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Súly visszaállítás hiba: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_call(:get_memory_pressure, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.memory_pressure_level, state}
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_cast({:set_offload_threshold, threshold}, state) do
    new_state = %{state | offload_threshold: threshold}
    Logger.info("Offload küszöb frissítve: #{threshold}")
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_info(:check_memory, state) do
    {:ok, new_state} = update_memory_status(state)
    
    # Memória nyomás ellenőrzése és automatikus offload
    new_state = check_memory_pressure_and_offload(new_state)
    
    # Következő ellenőrzés ütemezése
    schedule_memory_check(state.monitoring_interval)
    
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end
  
  # Privát segéd függvények
  
  defp update_memory_status(state) do
    try do
      # Julia bridge-en keresztül GPU memória lekérdezése
      gpu_info = call_julia_bridge(state.julia_bridge_pid, :get_gpu_memory)
      cpu_info = get_cpu_memory_info()
      
      new_state = %{state |
        gpu_memory_total: gpu_info.total,
        gpu_memory_used: gpu_info.used,
        gpu_memory_free: gpu_info.free,
        cpu_memory_used: cpu_info.used,
        last_check: DateTime.utc_now(),
        memory_pressure_level: calculate_memory_pressure(gpu_info)
      }
      
      {:ok, new_state}
    rescue
      error ->
        Logger.error("Memória állapot frissítési hiba: #{inspect(error)}")
        {:ok, state}
    end
  end
  
  defp call_julia_bridge(nil, _command), do: %{total: 0, used: 0, free: 0}
  defp call_julia_bridge(pid, command) when is_pid(pid) do
    try do
      GenServer.call(pid, command, 5000)
    rescue
      _ -> %{total: 0, used: 0, free: 0}
    end
  end
  
  defp get_cpu_memory_info do
    try do
      {result, 0} = System.cmd("free", ["-b"])
      
      [_header | lines] = String.split(result, "\n")
      [mem_line | _] = lines
      
      [_, total, used, free | _] = String.split(mem_line, ~r/\s+/)
      
      %{
        total: String.to_integer(total),
        used: String.to_integer(used),
        free: String.to_integer(free)
      }
    rescue
      _ -> %{total: 0, used: 0, free: 0}
    end
  end
  
  defp calculate_memory_pressure(gpu_info) do
    utilization = gpu_info.used / max(gpu_info.total, 1)
    
    cond do
      utilization > 0.9 -> :critical
      utilization > 0.8 -> :high
      utilization > 0.6 -> :medium
      true -> :low
    end
  end
  
  defp gpu_utilization(state) do
    case state.gpu_memory_total do
      0 -> 0.0
      total -> state.gpu_memory_used / total
    end
  end
  
  defp check_memory_pressure_and_offload(state) do
    utilization = gpu_utilization(state)
    
    if utilization > state.offload_threshold do
      # Automatikus offload az LRU stratégia alapján
      layers_to_offload = select_layers_for_offload(state)
      
      case offload_weights_to_cpu(layers_to_offload, state) do
        {:ok, new_state} ->
          Logger.warn("Automatikus offload: #{inspect(layers_to_offload)} (#{Float.round(utilization * 100, 1)}% felhasználtság)")
          new_state
        
        {:error, _reason} ->
          state
      end
    else
      state
    end
  end
  
  defp select_layers_for_offload(state) do
    # LRU stratégia: legrégebben használt súlyok kiválasztása
    state.offload_queue
    |> Enum.take(3)  # Maximum 3 réteg egyszerre
  end
  
  defp offload_weights_to_cpu(layer_names, state) do
    try do
      offloaded_weights = 
        for layer_name <- layer_names do
          # Julia bridge-en keresztül súly lekérése
          weight_data = call_julia_bridge(state.julia_bridge_pid, {:get_weights, layer_name})
          
          # CPU memóriába mentés
          cached_key = "offload_#{layer_name}_#{System.system_time(:millisecond)}"
          :ets.insert(:weight_cache, {cached_key, weight_data})
          
          # Julia-ból súly törlése
          call_julia_bridge(state.julia_bridge_pid, {:offload_weights, layer_name})
          
          {layer_name, cached_key}
        end
      
      new_weight_cache = 
        Enum.reduce(offloaded_weights, state.weight_cache, fn {layer, key}, cache ->
          Map.put(cache, layer, key)
        end)
      
      new_offload_queue = 
        state.offload_queue 
        |> Enum.reject(&(&1 in layer_names))
      
      new_state = %{state |
        weight_cache: new_weight_cache,
        offload_queue: new_offload_queue
      }
      
      {:ok, new_state}
    rescue
      error ->
        {:error, error}
    end
  end
  
  defp restore_weights_to_gpu(layer_names, state) do
    try do
      restored_layers =
        for layer_name <- layer_names do
          case Map.get(state.weight_cache, layer_name) do
            nil ->
              Logger.warn("Súly nem található a cache-ben: #{layer_name}")
              nil
            
            cache_key ->
              # Cache-ből súly lekérése
              [{^cache_key, weight_data}] = :ets.lookup(:weight_cache, cache_key)
              
              # Julia-ba súly visszaállítása
              call_julia_bridge(state.julia_bridge_pid, {:restore_weights, layer_name, weight_data})
              
              # Cache törlése
              :ets.delete(:weight_cache, cache_key)
              
              layer_name
          end
        end
        |> Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)
      
      new_weight_cache = 
        Enum.reduce(restored_layers, state.weight_cache, fn layer, cache ->
          Map.delete(cache, layer)
        end)
      
      new_offload_queue = state.offload_queue ++ restored_layers
      
      new_state = %{state |
        weight_cache: new_weight_cache,
        offload_queue: new_offload_queue
      }
      
      {:ok, new_state}
    rescue
      error ->
        {:error, error}
    end
  end
  
  defp schedule_memory_check(interval) do
    Process.send_after(self(), :check_memory, interval)
  end
  
  defp format_memory(bytes) when bytes > 1024 * 1024 * 1024 do
    "#{Float.round(bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024), 2)} GB"
  end
  
  defp format_memory(bytes) when bytes > 1024 * 1024 do
    "#{Float.round(bytes / (1024 * 1024), 2)} MB"
  end
  
  defp format_memory(bytes) do
    "#{bytes} bytes"
  end

# FlashMLA implementáció
function flash_mla_attention(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray, mask=nothing)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    # Query, Key, Value projekciók
    q = reshape(block.query_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    k = reshape(block.key_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    v = reshape(block.value_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    
    # Optimalizált flash attention számítás
    q = permutedims(q, (1, 3, 2, 4))  # [batch, heads, seq, head_dim]
    k = permutedims(k, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    v = permutedims(v, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    
    # Attention súlyok számítása blokkonként (FlashAttention stílusban)
    scale = 1.0f0 / sqrt(Float32(block.head_dim))
    attn_output = zeros(Float32, batch_size, block.num_heads, seq_len, block.head_dim)
    
    block_size = 128  # FlashAttention blokk méret
    for i in 1:block_size:seq_len
        i_end = min(i + block_size - 1, seq_len)
        for j in 1:block_size:seq_len
            j_end = min(j + block_size - 1, seq_len)
            
            # Blokk-alapú attention számítás
            q_block = q[:, :, i:i_end, :]
            k_block = k[:, :, j:j_end, :]
            v_block = v[:, :, j:j_end, :]
            
            scores = batched_mul(q_block, permutedims(k_block, (1, 2, 4, 3))) .* scale
            
            if mask !== nothing
                scores .+= mask[i:i_end, j:j_end]
            end
            
            attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
            attn_block = batched_mul(attn_weights, v_block)
            
            attn_output[:, :, i:i_end, :] .+= attn_block
        end
    end
    
    # Kimenet átformázása és projekció
    attn_output = permutedims(attn_output, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    attn_output = reshape(attn_output, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    return block.output_proj(attn_output)
end

function mamba2_ssm(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray)

    # A mátrix exponenciális (discretized)

    # Állapot inicializálás

    outputs = zeros(Float32, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    # Szekvenciális feldolgozás Mamba2 stílusban

        dt_t = dt[:, t, :]     # [batch, hidden]

    end
    
    # D skip connection hozzáadás

    return outputs

using LinearAlgebra
using CUDA

# Hibrid AMF blokk definíció
struct HybridAMFBlock
    # FlashMLA komponensek
    query_proj::Dense
    key_proj::Dense
    value_proj::Dense
    output_proj::Dense
    
    # Mamba2 komponensek
    x_proj::Dense
    dt_proj::Dense
    A_log::AbstractArray
    D::AbstractArray
    
    # AMF fúziós paraméterek
    fusion_gate::Dense
    alpha_weight::Float32
    beta_weight::Float32
    
    # Normalizációs rétegek
    norm1::LayerNorm
    norm2::LayerNorm
    
    # Konfigurációs paraméterek
    hidden_size::Int
    num_heads::Int
    head_dim::Int
    state_size::Int
end

# FlashMLA implementáció
function flash_mla_attention(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray, mask=nothing)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    # Query, Key, Value projekciók
    q = reshape(block.query_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    k = reshape(block.key_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    v = reshape(block.value_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    
    # Optimalizált flash attention számítás
    q = permutedims(q, (1, 3, 2, 4))  # [batch, heads, seq, head_dim]
    k = permutedims(k, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    v = permutedims(v, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    
    # Attention súlyok számítása blokkonként (FlashAttention stílusban)
    scale = 1.0f0 / sqrt(Float32(block.head_dim))
    attn_output = zeros(Float32, batch_size, block.num_heads, seq_len, block.head_dim)
    
    block_size = 128  # FlashAttention blokk méret
    for i in 1:block_size:seq_len
        i_end = min(i + block_size - 1, seq_len)
        for j in 1:block_size:seq_len
            j_end = min(j + block_size - 1, seq_len)
            
            # Blokk-alapú attention számítás
            q_block = q[:, :, i:i_end, :]
            k_block = k[:, :, j:j_end, :]
            v_block = v[:, :, j:j_end, :]
            
            scores = batched_mul(q_block, permutedims(k_block, (1, 2, 4, 3))) .* scale
            
            if mask !== nothing
                scores .+= mask[i:i_end, j:j_end]
            end
            
            attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
            attn_block = batched_mul(attn_weights, v_block)
            
            attn_output[:, :, i:i_end, :] .+= attn_block
        end
    end
    
    # Kimenet átformázása és projekció
    attn_output = permutedims(attn_output, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    attn_output = reshape(attn_output, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    return block.output_proj(attn_output)
end

# Mamba2 állapot-tér modell implementáció
function mamba2_ssm(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    # Projekciók
    x_proj = block.x_proj(x)
    dt = sigmoid.(block.dt_proj(x))  # Delta time paraméterek
    
    # A mátrix exponenciális (discretized)
    A = exp.(block.A_log)  # [state_size, hidden_size]
    
    # Állapot inicializálás
    h = zeros(Float32, batch_size, block.state_size, hidden_size)
    outputs = zeros(Float32, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    # Szekvenciális feldolgozás Mamba2 stílusban
    for t in 1:seq_len
        x_t = x_proj[:, t, :]  # [batch, hidden]
        dt_t = dt[:, t, :]     # [batch, hidden]
        
        # Állapot frissítés
        h = h .* reshape(A, 1, block.state_size, hidden_size) .+ 
            reshape(x_t, batch_size, 1, hidden_size)
        
        # Kimenet számítás
        y_t = sum(h .* reshape(dt_t, batch_size, 1, hidden_size), dims=2)
        outputs[:, t, :] = reshape(y_t, batch_size, hidden_size)
    end
    
    # D skip connection hozzáadás
    outputs .+= x .* reshape(block.D, 1, 1, hidden_size)
    
    return outputs
end

# AMF fúziós mechanizmus
function amf_fusion(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray, mask=nothing)
    # Normalizált bemenetek
    x_norm1 = block.norm1(x)
    x_norm2 = block.norm2(x)
    
    # FlashMLA és Mamba2 kimenetei
    flash_out = flash_mla_attention(block, x_norm1, mask)
    mamba_out = mamba2_ssm(block, x_norm2)
    
    # Adaptív fúzió gate
    fusion_weights = sigmoid.(block.fusion_gate(x))
    
    # Súlyozott kombinálás
    alpha = block.alpha_weight * fusion_weights
    beta = block.beta_weight * (1.0f0 .- fusion_weights)
    
    fused_output = alpha .* flash_out .+ beta .* mamba_out
    
    # Residual connection
    return x .+ fused_output
end

# Dinamikus pozíciós kódolás (YaRN/LongRoPE alapú)
function dynamic_positional_encoding(seq_len::Int, hidden_size::Int, theta::Float32=10000.0f0)
    pos = collect(0:seq_len-1)
    dims = collect(0:2:hidden_size-1)
    
    # YaRN-style dynamic scaling
    scale_factor = max(1.0f0, log(Float32(seq_len) / 4096.0f0))
    adjusted_theta = theta * scale_factor
    
    # RoPE frekvenciák számítása
    freqs = 1.0f0 ./ (adjusted_theta .^ (dims ./ hidden_size))
    
    # Pozíciós encoding mátrix
    pos_enc = zeros(Float32, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    for i in 1:seq_len
        for j in 1:2:hidden_size
            angle = pos[i] * freqs[div(j+1, 2)]
            pos_enc[i, j] = sin(angle)
            if j < hidden_size
                pos_enc[i, j+1] = cos(angle)
            end
        end
    end
    
    return pos_enc
end

# SEAL mechanizmus a hosszú szekvenciákhoz
function seal_mechanism(x::AbstractArray, memory_length::Int=65536)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    if seq_len <= memory_length
        return x  # Nincs szükség tömörítésre
    end
    
    # Adaptív tömörítés
    compress_ratio = div(seq_len, memory_length)
    compressed_seq = zeros(Float32, batch_size, memory_length, hidden_size)
    
    for i in 1:memory_length
        start_idx = (i-1) * compress_ratio + 1
        end_idx = min(i * compress_ratio, seq_len)
        
        if start_idx <= end_idx
            # Átlagolás alapú tömörítés
            compressed_seq[:, i, :] = mean(x[:, start_idx:end_idx, :], dims=2)
        end
    end
    
    return compressed_seq
end

# Teljes JAIDE v15 modell
struct JAIDEv15Model
    embedding::Embedding
    pos_encoding::AbstractArray
    
    # Hibrid AMF blokkok
    amf_blocks::Vector{HybridAMFBlock}
    
    # Kimeneti rétegek
    final_norm::LayerNorm
    lm_head::Dense
    
    # Konfigurációs paraméterek
    config::Dict{String, Any}
end

# Modell forward pass
function forward(model::JAIDEv15Model, input_ids::AbstractArray, attention_mask=nothing)
    batch_size, seq_len = size(input_ids)
    
    # Token embedding
    x = model.embedding(input_ids)
    
    # Dinamikus pozíciós kódolás hozzáadása
    pos_enc = dynamic_positional_encoding(seq_len, size(x, 3))
    x = x .+ reshape(pos_enc, 1, seq_len, size(x, 3))
    
    # SEAL mechanizmus alkalmazása hosszú szekvenciákhoz
    x = seal_mechanism(x, model.config["memory_length"])
    
    # Hibrid AMF blokkok iterálása
    for block in model.amf_blocks
        x = amf_fusion(block, x, attention_mask)
    end
    
    # Finális normalizálás és kimenet
    x = model.final_norm(x)
    logits = model.lm_head(x)
    
    return logits
end

# Modell konstruktor
function create_jaide_v15_model(config::Dict{String, Any})
    hidden_size = config["hidden_size"]
    num_layers = config["num_layers"]
    num_heads = config["num_heads"]
    vocab_size = config["vocab_size"]
    max_seq_len = config["max_seq_len"]
    
    # Embedding rétegek
    embedding = Embedding(vocab_size => hidden_size)
    pos_encoding = dynamic_positional_encoding(max_seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    # AMF blokkok létrehozása
    amf_blocks = []
    for i in 1:num_layers
        block = HybridAMFBlock(
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # query_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # key_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # value_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # output_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # x_proj
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # dt_proj
            randn(Float32, hidden_size, hidden_size),  # A_log
            randn(Float32, hidden_size),  # D
            Dense(hidden_size => hidden_size),  # fusion_gate
            0.5f0,  # alpha_weight
            0.5f0,  # beta_weight
            LayerNorm(hidden_size),  # norm1
            LayerNorm(hidden_size),  # norm2
            hidden_size,
            num_heads,
            div(hidden_size, num_heads),
            hidden_size
        )
        push!(amf_blocks, block)
    end
    
    # Kimeneti rétegek
    final_norm = LayerNorm(hidden_size)
    lm_head = Dense(hidden_size => vocab_size)
    
    return JAIDEv15Model(
        embedding,
        pos_encoding,
        amf_blocks,
        final_norm,
        lm_head,
        config
    )
end

# Segéd függvények
function batched_mul(a::AbstractArray, b::AbstractArray)
    return batched_transpose(batched_transpose(a) * batched_transpose(b))
end

function batched_transpose(x::AbstractArray)
    return permutedims(x, (1, 2, 4, 3))
end

defmodule JAIDEv15Api.MemoryManager do
  @moduledoc """
  GPU memória monitorozó és súly offload kezelő GenServer
  DeepSpeed ZeRO-Offload alapú implementáció
  """
  
  use GenServer
  require Logger
  
  # Állapot struktúra
  defstruct [
    :gpu_memory_total,
    :gpu_memory_used,
    :gpu_memory_free,
    :cpu_memory_used,
    :offload_threshold,
    :offload_strategy,
    :julia_bridge_pid,
    :weight_cache,
    :offload_queue,
    :monitoring_interval,
    :last_check,
    :memory_pressure_level
  ]
  
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
    gpu_memory_total: non_neg_integer(),
    gpu_memory_used: non_neg_integer(),
    gpu_memory_free: non_neg_integer(),
    cpu_memory_used: non_neg_integer(),
    offload_threshold: float(),
    offload_strategy: atom(),
    julia_bridge_pid: pid() | nil,
    weight_cache: map(),
    offload_queue: list(),
    monitoring_interval: non_neg_integer(),
    last_check: DateTime.t(),
    memory_pressure_level: atom()
  }
  
  # API függvények
  
  @spec start_link(keyword()) :: GenServer.on_start()
  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end
  
  @spec get_memory_status() :: map()
  def get_memory_status do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_memory_status)
  end
  
  @spec offload_weights(list()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
  def offload_weights(layer_names) when is_list(layer_names) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:offload_weights, layer_names})
  end
  
  @spec restore_weights(list()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
  def restore_weights(layer_names) when is_list(layer_names) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:restore_weights, layer_names})
  end
  
  @spec set_offload_threshold(float()) :: :ok
  def set_offload_threshold(threshold) when threshold > 0.0 and threshold < 1.0 do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:set_offload_threshold, threshold})
  end
  
  @spec get_memory_pressure() :: atom()
  def get_memory_pressure do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_memory_pressure)
  end
  
  # GenServer callbacks
  
  @impl GenServer
  def init(opts) do
    julia_bridge_pid = Keyword.get(opts, :julia_bridge_pid)
    offload_threshold = Keyword.get(opts, :offload_threshold, 0.85)
    monitoring_interval = Keyword.get(opts, :monitoring_interval, 1000)
    
    initial_state = %__MODULE__{
      gpu_memory_total: 0,
      gpu_memory_used: 0,
      gpu_memory_free: 0,
      cpu_memory_used: 0,
      offload_threshold: offload_threshold,
      offload_strategy: :lru,
      julia_bridge_pid: julia_bridge_pid,
      weight_cache: %{},
      offload_queue: [],
      monitoring_interval: monitoring_interval,
      last_check: DateTime.utc_now(),
      memory_pressure_level: :low
    }
    
    # Kezdeti memória állapot lekérdezése
    {:ok, state} = update_memory_status(initial_state)
    
    # Periodikus memória ellenőrzés indítása
    schedule_memory_check(monitoring_interval)
    
    Logger.info("MemoryManager elindult. GPU memória: #{format_memory(state.gpu_memory_total)}")
    
    {:ok, state}
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_call(:get_memory_status, _from, state) do
    status = %{
      gpu_total: state.gpu_memory_total,
      gpu_used: state.gpu_memory_used,
      gpu_free: state.gpu_memory_free,
      gpu_utilization: gpu_utilization(state),
      cpu_used: state.cpu_memory_used,
      memory_pressure: state.memory_pressure_level,
      offload_threshold: state.offload_threshold,
      cached_weights: map_size(state.weight_cache),
      offload_queue_size: length(state.offload_queue)
    }
    
    {:reply, status, state}
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_call({:offload_weights, layer_names}, _from, state) do
    case offload_weights_to_cpu(layer_names, state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        Logger.info("Súlyok offload befejezve: #{inspect(layer_names)}")
        {:reply, :ok, new_state}
      
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Súly offload hiba: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_call({:restore_weights, layer_names}, _from, state) do
    case restore_weights_to_gpu(layer_names, state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        Logger.info("Súlyok visszaállítva GPU-ra: #{inspect(layer_names)}")
        {:reply, :ok, new_state}
      
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Súly visszaállítás hiba: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_call(:get_memory_pressure, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.memory_pressure_level, state}
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_cast({:set_offload_threshold, threshold}, state) do
    new_state = %{state | offload_threshold: threshold}
    Logger.info("Offload küszöb frissítve: #{threshold}")
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end
  
  @impl GenServer
  def handle_info(:check_memory, state) do
    {:ok, new_state} = update_memory_status(state)
    
    # Memória nyomás ellenőrzése és automatikus offload
    new_state = check_memory_pressure_and_offload(new_state)
    
    # Következő ellenőrzés ütemezése
    schedule_memory_check(state.monitoring_interval)
    
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end
  
  # Privát segéd függvények
  
  defp update_memory_status(state) do
    try do
      # Julia bridge-en keresztül GPU memória lekérdezése
      gpu_info = call_julia_bridge(state.julia_bridge_pid, :get_gpu_memory)
      cpu_info = get_cpu_memory_info()
      
      new_state = %{state |
        gpu_memory_total: gpu_info.total,
        gpu_memory_used: gpu_info.used,
        gpu_memory_free: gpu_info.free,
        cpu_memory_used: cpu_info.used,
        last_check: DateTime.utc_now(),
        memory_pressure_level: calculate_memory_pressure(gpu_info)
      }
      
      {:ok, new_state}
    rescue
      error ->
        Logger.error("Memória állapot frissítési hiba: #{inspect(error)}")
        {:ok, state}
    end
  end
  
  defp call_julia_bridge(nil, _command), do: %{total: 0, used: 0, free: 0}
  defp call_julia_bridge(pid, command) when is_pid(pid) do
    try do
      GenServer.call(pid, command, 5000)
    rescue
      _ -> %{total: 0, used: 0, free: 0}
    end
  end
  
  defp get_cpu_memory_info do
    try do
      {result, 0} = System.cmd("free", ["-b"])
      
      [_header | lines] = String.split(result, "\n")
      [mem_line | _] = lines
      
      [_, total, used, free | _] = String.split(mem_line, ~r/\s+/)
      
      %{
        total: String.to_integer(total),
        used: String.to_integer(used),
        free: String.to_integer(free)
      }
    rescue
      _ -> %{total: 0, used: 0, free: 0}
    end
  end
  
  defp calculate_memory_pressure(gpu_info) do
    utilization = gpu_info.used / max(gpu_info.total, 1)
    
    cond do
      utilization > 0.9 -> :critical
      utilization > 0.8 -> :high
      utilization > 0.6 -> :medium
      true -> :low
    end
  end
  
  defp gpu_utilization(state) do
    case state.gpu_memory_total do
      0 -> 0.0
      total -> state.gpu_memory_used / total
    end
  end
  
  defp check_memory_pressure_and_offload(state) do
    utilization = gpu_utilization(state)
    
    if utilization > state.offload_threshold do
      # Automatikus offload az LRU stratégia alapján
      layers_to_offload = select_layers_for_offload(state)
      
      case offload_weights_to_cpu(layers_to_offload, state) do
        {:ok, new_state} ->
          Logger.warn("Automatikus offload: #{inspect(layers_to_offload)} (#{Float.round(utilization * 100, 1)}% felhasználtság)")
          new_state
        
        {:error, _reason} ->
          state
      end
    else
      state
    end
  end
  
  defp select_layers_for_offload(state) do
    # LRU stratégia: legrégebben használt súlyok kiválasztása
    state.offload_queue
    |> Enum.take(3)  # Maximum 3 réteg egyszerre
  end
  
  defp offload_weights_to_cpu(layer_names, state) do
    try do
      offloaded_weights = 
        for layer_name <- layer_names do
          # Julia bridge-en keresztül súly lekérése
          weight_data = call_julia_bridge(state.julia_bridge_pid, {:get_weights, layer_name})
          
          # CPU memóriába mentés
          cached_key = "offload_#{layer_name}_#{System.system_time(:millisecond)}"
          :ets.insert(:weight_cache, {cached_key, weight_data})
          
          # Julia-ból súly törlése
          call_julia_bridge(state.julia_bridge_pid, {:offload_weights, layer_name})
          
          {layer_name, cached_key}
        end
      
      new_weight_cache = 
        Enum.reduce(offloaded_weights, state.weight_cache, fn {layer, key}, cache ->
          Map.put(cache, layer, key)
        end)
      
      new_offload_queue = 
        state.offload_queue 
        |> Enum.reject(&(&1 in layer_names))
      
      new_state = %{state |
        weight_cache: new_weight_cache,
        offload_queue: new_offload_queue
      }
      
      {:ok, new_state}
    rescue
      error ->
        {:error, error}
    end
  end
  
  defp restore_weights_to_gpu(layer_names, state) do
    try do
      restored_layers =
        for layer_name <- layer_names do
          case Map.get(state.weight_cache, layer_name) do
            nil ->
              Logger.warn("Súly nem található a cache-ben: #{layer_name}")
              nil
            
            cache_key ->
              # Cache-ből súly lekérése
              [{^cache_key, weight_data}] = :ets.lookup(:weight_cache, cache_key)
              
              # Julia-ba súly visszaállítása
              call_julia_bridge(state.julia_bridge_pid, {:restore_weights, layer_name, weight_data})
              
              # Cache törlése
              :ets.delete(:weight_cache, cache_key)
              
              layer_name
          end
        end
        |> Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)
      
      new_weight_cache = 
        Enum.reduce(restored_layers, state.weight_cache, fn layer, cache ->
          Map.delete(cache, layer)
        end)
      
      new_offload_queue = state.offload_queue ++ restored_layers
      
      new_state = %{state |
        weight_cache: new_weight_cache,
        offload_queue: new_offload_queue
      }
      
      {:ok, new_state}
    rescue
      error ->
        {:error, error}
    end

function flash_mla_attention(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray, mask=nothing)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    # Query, Key, Value projekciók
    q = reshape(block.query_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    k = reshape(block.key_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    v = reshape(block.value_proj(x), batch_size, seq_len, block.num_heads, block.head_dim)
    
    # Optimalizált flash attention számítás
    q = permutedims(q, (1, 3, 2, 4))  # [batch, heads, seq, head_dim]
    k = permutedims(k, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    v = permutedims(v, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    
    # Attention súlyok számítása blokkonként (FlashAttention stílusban)
    scale = 1.0f0 / sqrt(Float32(block.head_dim))
    attn_output = zeros(Float32, batch_size, block.num_heads, seq_len, block.head_dim)
    
    block_size = 128  # FlashAttention blokk méret
    for i in 1:block_size:seq_len
        i_end = min(i + block_size - 1, seq_len)
        for j in 1:block_size:seq_len
            j_end = min(j + block_size - 1, seq_len)
            
            # Blokk-alapú attention számítás
            q_block = q[:, :, i:i_end, :]
            k_block = k[:, :, j:j_end, :]
            v_block = v[:, :, j:j_end, :]
            
            scores = batched_mul(q_block, permutedims(k_block, (1, 2, 4, 3))) .* scale
            
            if mask !== nothing
                scores .+= mask[i:i_end, j:j_end]
            end
            
            attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
            attn_block = batched_mul(attn_weights, v_block)
            
            attn_output[:, :, i:i_end, :] .+= attn_block
        end
    end
    
    # Kimenet átformázása és projekció
    attn_output = permutedims(attn_output, (1, 3, 2, 4))
    attn_output = reshape(attn_output, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    return block.output_proj(attn_output)
end

function mamba2_ssm(block::HybridAMFBlock, x::AbstractArray)
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = size(x)
    
    # Projekciók
    x_proj = block.x_proj(x)
    dt = sigmoid.(block.dt_proj(x))  # Delta time paraméterek
    
    # A mátrix exponenciális (discretized)
    A = exp.(block.A_log)  # [state_size, hidden_size]
    
    # Állapot inicializálás
    h = zeros(Float32, batch_size, block.state_size, hidden_size)
    outputs = zeros(Float32, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    # Szekvenciális feldolgozás Mamba2 stílusban
    for t in 1:seq_len
        x_t = x_proj[:, t, :]  # [batch, hidden]
        dt_t = dt[:, t, :]     # [batch, hidden]
        
        # Állapot frissítés
        h = h .* reshape(A, 1, block.state_size, hidden_size) .+ 
            reshape(x_t, batch_size, 1, hidden_size)
        
        # Kimenet számítás
        y_t = sum(h .* reshape(dt_t, batch_size, 1, hidden_size), dims=2)
        outputs[:, t, :] = reshape(y_t, batch_size, hidden_size)
    end
    
    # D skip connection hozzáadás
    outputs .+= x .* reshape(block.D, 1, 1, hidden_size)
    
    return outputs
end
